sql.sql: select spclty, decile, count(*) n from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER group by 1,2 order by 1,2
select call_typ, min(call_dt), max(call_dt), count(*), count(distinct prscrbr_me), count(distinct rep_id) from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_ACT group by 1
select team, count(*) from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.REP_ROSTER group by 1
select table_schema, table_name, column_name, comment from PHARMA_DEMO.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where table_schema in ('CORE','BIZ','REF','MART') and comment is not null

select c.rep_id, r.team, count(*) n, min(call_dt), max(call_dt) from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_ACT c left join PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.REP_ROSTER r on c.rep_id=r.rep_id where r.rep_id is null or r.team='INDIGO' group by 1,2 order by 1
select * from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.REP_ROSTER where team='INDIGO' or rep_id in ('R047','R048')

with rx as (
 select r.prscrbr_me,
  sum(case when m.mkt_def='DRY_EYE' then trx_qty else 0 end) de_trx,
  sum(case when m.mkt_def='GLAUCOMA' then trx_qty else 0 end) gl_trx
 from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY r join PHARMA_DEMO.BIZ.MKT_DEF_DRIVER m on r.prod_ndc11=m.prod_ndc11
 where r.wk_end_dt > dateadd(week,-52,(select max(wk_end_dt) from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY))
 group by 1)
select p.decile, count(*) n, count(rx.prscrbr_me) with_rx, round(avg(de_trx)) avg_de, min(de_trx), max(de_trx), round(avg(gl_trx)) avg_gl
from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p left join rx on p.prscrbr_me=rx.prscrbr_me group by 1 order by 1

select table_schema, table_name, column_name, data_type from PHARMA_DEMO.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where table_schema not in ('INFORMATION_SCHEMA') and (column_name ilike any ('%OPT%','%PDRP%','%RESTR%','%CONSENT%','%CONTACT%','%DNC%','%FLAG%','%FLG%','%STATUS%','%ACTIVE%','%DECILE%','%SEG%')) order by 1,2

select count(*) calls, count_if(p.prscrbr_me is null) unmatched, count(distinct c.prscrbr_me) d, count_if(c.rep_id not in (select rep_id from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.REP_ROSTER)) bad_rep, count_if(c.call_dt is null) null_dt
from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_ACT c left join PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p on c.prscrbr_me=p.prscrbr_me
select count(*), count(distinct prscrbr_me), count(distinct npi), count_if(decile is null), count_if(terr_id is null) from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER

with last_call as (
  select c.prscrbr_me, max(c.call_dt) last_call_dt, count(*) calls_12m
  from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_ACT c group by 1),
recent as (
  select distinct prscrbr_me from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_ACT
  where call_dt > dateadd(day,-90,'2026-09-30'::date)),
de as (
  select r.prscrbr_me, sum(trx_qty) de_trx_13w
  from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY r join PHARMA_DEMO.BIZ.MKT_DEF_DRIVER m on r.prod_ndc11=m.prod_ndc11 and m.mkt_def='DRY_EYE'
  where r.wk_end_dt > dateadd(week,-13,(select max(wk_end_dt) from PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY))
  group by 1)
select p.prscrbr_me, p.npi, p.prscrbr_nm, p.spclty, p.decile, p.terr_id, t.district_id, p.account_id,
  lc.last_call_dt, datediff(day, lc.last_call_dt, '2026-09-30'::date) days_since, lc.calls_12m, de.de_trx_13w,
  (select listagg(rep_id||'/'||team, ', ') from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.REP_ROSTER rr where rr.terr_id=p.terr_id) terr_reps
from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p
left join PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.TERRITORY t on p.terr_id=t.terr_id
left join last_call lc on p.prscrbr_me=lc.prscrbr_me
left join de on p.prscrbr_me=de.prscrbr_me
where p.decile >= 8 and p.prscrbr_me not in (select prscrbr_me from recent)
order by p.decile desc, de.de_trx_13w desc
select date_trunc(month, call_dt) m, count(*) calls, count(distinct prscrbr_me) hcps, count(distinct rep_id) reps from PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.CALL_ACT where call_dt >= '2026-04-01' group by 1 order by 1
